== Acquisition ==
This skill can be temporarily acquired by [[Primary profession|primary]] [[Ritualist]]s, [[Paragon]]s and [[Dervish]]es by talking to [[Kuunavang]] in [[Raisu Palace]], [[Imperial Sanctum]] or [[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]].

== Notes ==
* The skill descriptions omit that this skill can only be recharged when gaining a [[Morale Boost]].
* This skill will inflict at least 5 [[packet]]s of 200 [[damage]] to [[foe]]s within [[range]] and will give all [[party member]]s within range a level 5 [[Shield of Saint Viktor]] effect.
* The same foe cannot be struck by more than one damage packet.
* Its range is less than the [[aggro]] bubble.
